concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: preliminary logo exploration for SNODO, an Italian social place-discovery app for choosing places individually and together with friends. Create one refined graphic-design presentation board in landscape format, clean white background, very generous whitespace and precise editorial alignment. Flat vector-like graphics with smooth crisp contours, no photography, no 3D, no shadows, no gradients, no textures. Three arranged specimens of THE SAME consistent logo: a large primary horizontal symbol-plus-wordmark in the upper two thirds, a smaller solid black monochrome version below left, and a standalone symbol inside a rounded square app tile below right. The exact brand word is "SNODO", S N O D O, all uppercase, spelled perfectly once in each wordmark. Wordmark has black heavy geometric display typography, confident and playful, broad round O counters and slightly compact S N D, sympathetic to Boldonse. Use existing Pop palette only: turquoise #80EFED, pink #FD87BA, lime #ADE25D, purple #9E6CDA, yellow #FCEC52, and black and white. Avoid using every color together. No taglines, annotations, labels, captions, watermarks or other text. Keep the symbol bold and simple enough to survive reduction to 24px. This is a professional identity concept, restrained and memorable.
Concept 1 — NODO / S. Design a distinctive compact monogram S made from one broad smooth ribbon with two bends, evoking paths meeting and an open knot. A short crossing or negative-space interruption creates an elegant interconnection, but preserve a clear S silhouette. No literal rope, no infinity or figure-eight silhouette, no chain-link, no pin, no intricate tiny details. Main symbol is purple with ONE small turquoise junction accent, to the left of the black wordmark. The black version must retain the same S outline and crossing by white negative space. Turquoise rounded app tile with the black S symbol. Brand feels social, contemporary, energetic and approachable.

Concept 2 — PUNTO D'INCONTRO. Design a compact abstract meeting-point symbol made of three bold rounded directional shapes converging around a small circular white negative-space center, implying three people bringing preferences to a shared destination. Three arms asymmetrically spaced in a harmonious triangular composition, each with a distinct clear outline; can evoke a small meeting flower or a friendly junction but NOT a network diagram or transport logo. Pink, lime and purple form the three main shapes. Black wordmark on the right. In the monochrome specimen preserve separations between shapes using white gaps and keep exactly the same geometry. Pink rounded-square app tile with the symbol in solid black. No additional people icons, map pins, arrows, letter S or starbursts.

Concept 3 — DIALOGO TYPOGRAPHIC WORDMARK. This board must be led by a custom wordmark, so omit any separate symbol to the left of the main wordmark. Design a bold beautifully kerned custom "SNODO" wordmark with BOTH O letters subtly modified into circular conversation bubbles: one small rounded speech-tail pointing down-right on the first O and one small rounded tail pointing down-left on the last O. Keep the O letters completely readable and preserve the clean black SN D forms. First O black and last O purple, with other letters black. Avoid inserting extra symbols inside the O counters. The two O shapes should suggest two people talking without making an illustration. In the smaller monochrome version all letters black and both tails retained. For the turquoise app tile, use only the two bold circular speech-bubble O forms diagonally overlapping slightly, with a clear white negative gap separating them, all in black. Friendly, confident, playful and compact. No lowercase, no extra lettering.

explorations.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a professional deep brand exploration board in landscape 1536x1024 proportions for SNODO, a place-discovery app that helps friends decide where to go. The attached image is a reference for the established starting identity. Create a purposeful identity system with three alternative refinements OF THIS SAME concept, not unrelated logos. Existing exact colors: black, white, turquoise #80EFED, pink #FD87BA, lime #ADE25D, purple #9E6CDA, yellow #FCEC52. Flat crisp vector-like design, completely solid fills, no gradients or texture. White presentation background. Top half: three evenly spaced large symbol designs with a small bold correct "SNODO" wordmark beneath each, consistent display-geometric uppercase type. Bottom half: a cohesive restrained editorial mini-application system using the most compelling refinement: an app icon on rounded color tile, a small mobile welcome-screen mockup, and a poster/banner using enlarged cropped brand forms. Precise layout, spacious, polished, not crowded. No text anywhere except exactly "SNODO". All SNODO spelling S N O D O must be correct, unambiguous O not Q. No photos, no taglines, no fake UI paragraphs, no labels or numbers. Preserve concept recognizable relationship to reference.
Explore THE S / PATH JUNCTION concept in the attached reference. All three symbols must clearly read S. Variant A: simplify the purple chunky open S ribbon by removing the tiny turquoise diamond and preserving one clean negative-space crossing. Variant B: a fluid S built from two smoothly interlocking rounded path segments, one black and one purple, separated by a small white gap; no infinity. Variant C: a compact very bold S monogram with one small circular junction, generous counters and fewer details, suitable at 24 pixels. Favor A for the applications: black S on turquoise app icon, strong black SNODO on turquoise welcome screen, purple S cropped as an expressive route on a lime poster. Avoid chain-link or rope aesthetic, lightning bolts, arrows and star symbols. Make three variations meaningfully different.

Explore THE SHARED MEETING POINT concept of three rounded arms surrounding a common center in the reference. Variant A: three soft asymmetric pink/lime/purple petals around a clear circular white center, rounded and welcoming. Variant B: three more geometric compact rounded wedges converging toward a single white circle, more stable and structured. Variant C: same three parts all black, separated by generous negative gaps, with large center optimized for small size. Preserve exactly three parts, no literal faces or hands or pins, do not make a radiation hazard pictogram. Favor A for the application system: three black parts on pink app tile, colorful symbol and black SNODO on white welcome screen, large petal forms in pink and lime and purple as framing motif of a yellow poster. Avoid rotation effects suggesting a fan, no 3D.

Explore THE DIALOGUE WORDMARK identity from the reference, where the brand name stays clearly SNODO and two O-inspired speech bubbles form the separate app symbol. Top row, treat each specimen as a different wordmark-plus-small-dialogue-symbol layout. Variant A: very bold black SNODO with purple final plain round O, accompanied by two separate clean circular speech bubbles. Variant B: bold black SNODO with BOTH plain round O letters purple and more open spacing, plus twin circular chat bubbles horizontally facing one another. Variant C: compact black SNODO all monochrome with slightly softer corners, plus vertically interlocking pair of circular speech bubbles. The wordmark O letters NEVER have speech tails, no Q letters or SNQDQ. Favor A for the applications: twin black chat bubble annuli on turquoise app icon, large black SNODO with purple O on white mobile welcome screen, purple and turquoise circular outlines as editorial pattern on pink poster. No extra S monogram, no map pins, no generic messenger app imitation.
